pages.before: for (const vt of [...document.querySelectorAll(".vt[data-for]")]) { const id = vt.dataset.for; const chart = document.getElementById(id), table = document.getElementById(id + "-table"); if (!chart || !table) continue; vt.querySelector("[data-m=table]").click(); await wait(250); vt.querySelector("[data-m=chart]").click(); await wait(250); const panels = document.createElement("div"); panels.id = id + "-panels"; panels.className = "vt-panels"; chart.before(panels); panels.append(chart, table); table.removeAttribute("hidden"); vt.id = id + "-tabs"; vt.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b) => b.removeAttribute("aria-pressed")); } const css = document.createElement("style"); css.textContent = ".vt-panels > * + *{display:none}.vt-panels > [data-vt-state~=on]{display:block}.vt-panels:has(> * + [data-vt-state~=on]) > :first-child{display:none}.vt button[aria-current=true]{background:var(--hover);color:var(--ink)}"; document.head.append(css);
